policies.name: safe-classifications-are-released
policies.code: permit(principal, action == Action::"release", resource) when { context.classification == "public" || context.classification == "internal" };

policies.name: restricted-content-is-never-released
policies.code: forbid(principal, action == Action::"release", resource) when { context.classification == "restricted" };

tests.name: the read itself is allowed - content is unknown before the fetch
public content is released to the agent
internal content is released to the agent
restricted content is withheld - the forbid boundary
